title: Meta's Muse AI can now make phone calls for users
excerpt: Meta has updated its Muse AI agent to make calls on behalf of users with a paid subscription.
body_html:
Meta has introduced a new capability for its Muse artificial intelligence agent, allowing the tool to make phone calls on behalf of users. According to the updates, the feature is available specifically for individuals who hold a paid subscription.

With this functionality, the AI agent is designed to handle various phone-based tasks. Users can utilize the tool to schedule appointments, make reservations, and wait on hold during phone calls.
